decisions: ResolveValueGenericSpecialization unwraps ref input syntax to infer the element type, then resolves deferred input, return and additional parameter types through ParseSpecializedFunctionType.
Input compatibility is checked for new and reused specialization names.
ValidateUserFunction scopes its concrete value argument with save/restore; ArrayRepeatCount is shared by array inference and contextual fixed/bounded checks.
The metadata binding uses the existing typed IR integer specialization rules and actual call value.
Primary element type, nullable secondary/tertiary slots and concrete signature types share one FunctionBinding.
Source generic parameters used temporarily in native IR are excluded from the runtime additional parameter stream.
Header and tail use the shared compiled part plans; value-specialized additional parameters have no deferred template.
Body type registration consumes the same ordinary/value specialization binder rather than duplicating value binding.

existingSlgBodySupport.decision: Concrete value arguments already specialize body names and symbolic extents; the CSharp repeat-count correction follows that decision.

prohibitedShortcuts: No supplied CSharp function string or numeric type IDs
No dropping a runtime parameter count check to accept temporary constant slots
